caption: Domplein, Utrecht
composition: Unfinished west wall of the Domkerk and nave lines in the square · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On Domplein the view looks east to the Domkerk. The west wall is a low, unfinished Gothic front, because the nave between church and tower fell in 1674. Pale lines in the cobbles mark that missing nave. The sky is partly cloudy, about 14.3°C, with wind near 8.3 km/h. The freestanding Dom Tower is behind the camera and is not in this frame.
